verdict.rationale: LanceDB Enterprise docs confirm API key and OAuth2 authentication for remote table access, plus SOC2/HIPAA/GDPR compliance claims, but there is no evidence of role-based access control or per-collection/table-level permission granularity. Missing for 10: documented roles/RBAC system, per-collection or per-table permission scoping, and any admin API/UI for managing granular access policies.
